partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Specific drug binding and inhibition without adverse evidence
results.hypothesis: Precision improves when the direct-binding and inhibition rule is restricted to drugs, specific MONDO diseases, and pairs without explicit adverse relations.
results.body: drug binds and decreases causal gene; qualified gene degree <=50; MONDO disease with 1-500 descendants; no has_side_effect, contraindicated_in, exacerbates_condition, or causes edge from drug to disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Retains the same target-level mechanism while excluding broad disease hubs and graph evidence that the chemical worsens rather than treats the condition.
results.trapi_notes: The positive and adverse graph patterns are TRAPI-expressible; degree and absence constraints require Cypher or post-processing.

results.name: Curated-effect specific drug mechanism
results.hypothesis: Requiring a curated SIGNOR perturbation edge further enriches the specific drug binding-and-inhibition rule.
results.body: R017 plus affects primary source infores:signor
results.mechanism_rationale: Uses a curated directional perturbation source in addition to direct binding, disease causality, specificity, and adverse-edge exclusion.
results.trapi_notes: Positive, adverse, and provenance constraints can be represented in TRAPI only partly; degree and absence handling are easier in Cypher.
